policy: Default parallel-analysis feature; at least 2048 resamples and 32 observations; available_parallelism capped at 8. Independent scoped OS threads, all joined before returning. No global Rayon or benchmark worker pool usage.
reproducibility: Coordinator walks the original rejection-sampling RNG to establish exact chunk boundary states. Workers retain original generation order. Serial mode keeps its original loop and memory behavior. Parallel mode requires temporary row buffers in addition to output distributions.
